name: seller-card
title: Seller card
description: Who sells this: name, verification in words, rating, items sold, reply time and member since, with Contact and Visit store as separate actions.
docs: Pass the seller as data: name, an optional logo (initials are drawn without one), verified, rating with reviews, itemsSold, replyMinutes and memberSince as an ISO date. What is missing is left out; a seller with no sales and no reviews shows New seller, and a rating is only shown with a review count above zero. The rating is the inline rating, so it says the same sentence to a screen reader. Contact is a button (onContact) or, with contactHref, a link; Visit store appears when you pass storeHref. The figures sit in a row once the card is wide enough and in a list when it is not, whatever the screen. compact is the smaller card for beside the price; a long name wraps to two lines and is in the title of the heading. Always pass locale so the numbers and the date match on the server and in the browser; a bare memberSince date is a calendar day and ignores timeZone. labels holds every word.
